# Unrestor

> Unrestor is a free, open-source macOS menu-bar app and command-line tool that keeps a MacBook awake with the lid closed while a command, process, or timer runs, then lets it sleep again. Battery and heat limits are enforced by a small background service and always win. No account, no analytics, no tracking. Apache-2.0. Requires macOS 14 or later.

Unrestor is a personal project that is open source but not open for contributions: outside pull requests are rejected, forks are welcome, and issues are welcome with no guarantee of a reply or fix.

Install (Homebrew), then set up the background service once:

    brew install --cask GAM3RG33K/tap/unrestor
    sudo unrestor install

Typical use:

    unrestor run -- npm run build        # awake only while the command runs
    unrestor run --for 2h -- claude      # any tool, capped at two hours
    unrestor watch 4821                  # awake while process 4821 runs
    unrestor hold --for 90m              # a plain keep-awake with a timer
    unrestor status                      # what is holding the Mac awake, and why
